thesis.infer: Flat funding with BTC OI building suggests positions are being added without leverage stress, while the drop is smaller than the Nasdaq move, so we read the tape as partly macro-led and partly idiosyncratic. Consensus is pricing a calm regime (VIX under 20); we read the risk as sentiment (F&G 68 to 50) catching down to a hawkish backdrop (10Y 5.13%, Brent $115) and a tech-led equity drawdown that crypto has not yet fully echoed. The disagreement is a risk-on regime against a Restrictive Macro lens.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): BTC chops around the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) into the Oct 28 FOMC; a daily close above $81.7K keeps the hl-cycles confirm condition in view, a daily close below it is the stated invalidation. Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below the True Market Mean ($79.4K) could put the STH cost basis ($74.6K) in play, more likely with a hawkish surprise or a VIX close above 25. Second tail case (low-confidence): a further Nasdaq leg lower may drag crypto if BTC OI keeps building into weakness; risk skews slightly to the downside while Macro stays Restrictive.
